Article Title: Raids in four Kashmir districts in anti-national narrative case
Article Text:
Anantnag: Security personnel conduct a raid to crack down on alleged terror-related activities , in Anantnag, Jammu and Kashmir. (PTI Photo)

SRINAGAR: J&K Police’s Counter Intelligence Kashmir (CIK) unit Saturday conducted searches at five locations across four districts of the Valley in a case involving allegations of posting content aimed at building an anti-national narrative.The searches were carried out at two locations in Baramulla district and one each in Bandipora, Anantnag and Shopian districts. Electronic and digital storage devices and other material linked to the case were seized during the raids, police said. No arrests have been made so far.The case was registered at the CIK police station under various sections of IPC and UAPA.
Article Summary: J&K Police’s Counter Intelligence Kashmir (CIK) unit conducted searches at five locations across four districts of the Valley. The searches were carried out at two locations in Baramulla district and one each in Bandipora, Anantnag and Shopian districts. No arrests have been made so far.

Article Title: Rahul Gandhi slams BJP over NEET protest crackdown, says students were forced to apologise
Article Text:
Rahul Gandhi slams BJP over NEET crackdown

NEW DELHI: Standing with a group of youngsters who faced police action during the NEET protests , Congress leader Rahul Gandhi Wednesday said the ruling party is sending goons to the homes of students and forcing them to apologise, after which those apologies are being accepted by the PM.“There is no question of the youngsters apologising… I am very proud of them and what thousands of them did… They defended the Constitution and protected the idea of India and India’s future,” Rahul said.The Congress leader held a “freewheeling” discussion at his residence with a group of youngsters who participated in the protests at Jantar Mantar and other parts of the country. It included Riya Ahir whose photo went viral after she stood in front of a police van in Mumbai and Muskan Sharma who was victim of a cop “jabbing a baton into her buttocks” at Jantar Mantar on July 20. Farah Naaz alleged that in police detention, she faced communal barbs with a cop even calling her “anti-national”. Muskan said she was being assumed to be a Muslim which makes an Indian a “fair game”, even clarifying that she is a Hindu. Nutan Toppo said a pellet gun was fired at her.The leader of opposition’s decision to meet the youngsters to 10, Janpath, for a chat further upped the ante in the “BJP vs opposition” confrontation that has jammed the ongoing monsoon session of parliament.Continuing its aggression, a large contingent of opposition MPs marched inside the Parliament complex to protest the “absence of Amit Shah from parliament” and “Ayodhya donation scam”. The group included Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi, Dimple Yadav, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, Dharmendra Yadav, Supriya Sule, NK Premachandran, Sagarika Ghose, Amar Singh, Chowdry Mohd Ramzan, John Brittas, Sandosh Kumar, Naseer Hussain, K Radhakrishnan.Rahul held a placard with a face riddled with pellet gun injuries and a question “who gave the order?” The members also sought statehood for J&K.Addressing the media with the youngsters, Rahul said, “They are so young and standing before the media. But the prime minister and the home minister have no courage to stand before the press."He attacked home minister Amit Shah by saying that he is responsible for the crackdown on youngsters but “he does not have the decency to come to the Parliament, and the courage to comment on what happened.”Rahul took a jibe at PM Narendra Modi for saying that he has forgiven the students.
Article Summary: The Congress leader held a “freewheeling’ discussion at his residence with a group of youngsters who participated in the protests at Jantar Mantar and other parts of the country. The group included Riya Ahir whose photo went viral after she stood in front of a police van in Mumbai and Muskan Sharma who was victim of a cop “jabbing a baton into her buttocks”

Article Title: 3 rebel TMC MPs to meet Prime Minister today
Article Text:
Three minority breakaway Trinamool Congress MPs will meet PM Modi over breakfast on Friday

KOLKATA/NEW DELHI: Three minority breakaway Trinamool Congress MPs, who are now with the Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI) and have so far refused to be a part of the BJP-led NDA, will meet PM Narendra Modi over breakfast on Friday.Murshidabad lawmakers Abu Taher Khan, Khalilur Rahaman and Yusuf Pathan met Union minister Amit Shah on Thursday to voice concerns over SIR tribunals and the removal of loudspeakers from mosques.They have so far stayed away from two NDA meetings. The other 17 NCPI legislators, alongside six Shiv Sena MPs who support the NDA, will also meet the prime minister Friday.
Article Summary: Murshidabad lawmakers Abu Taher Khan, Khalilur Rahaman and Yusuf Pathan met Union minister Amit Shah on Thursday. They have so far stayed away from two NDA meetings. The other 17 NCPI legislators, alongside six Shiv Sena MPs who support the NDA, will also meet the prime minister.

Article Title: 'Hands off Jantar Mantar!' CJP says 'won't tolerate' bid to take away protest site after HC poser
Article Text:
CJP reacts to HC hearing on Jantar Mantar as the protest venue site

'Why should the city be put to ransom unnecessarily': Delhi HC

NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Saurav Das on Friday defended Jantar Mantar as Delhi's key protest venue after the Delhi HC questioned whether demonstrations should continue in the heart of the capital.In a post on X, Das wrote, "HANDS OFF our Jantar Mantar!" He alleged that after public protests were no longer allowed at India Gate, any move to shift demonstrations away from Jantar Mantar would curtail citizens' democratic rights."Before trying to take away our protest site, tell us if you will designate the India Gate where we can exercise our fundamental right to peacefully protest. You took away the India Gate.We will not tolerate taking away of OUR Jantar Mantar too!" he said.Also read: Jantar Mantar 'terror plot' row: Amritsar top cop Gurpreet Bhullar shunted; BJP cries foul Das's remarks came after Justice Amit Mahajan, while hearing a petition seeking permission to hold a protest at Jantar Mantar, orally observed that protests should not inconvenience the city and asked, "Why should the city be put to ransom unnecessarily?"The court directed Delhi Police to decide the petitioner's request by Saturday but did not order whether permission should be granted or denied.The issue of whether Jantar Mantar should remain Delhi's designated protest site is also pending before the Supreme Court, which is examining a plea seeking an alternative venue for demonstrations in the national capital.
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Saurav Das defended Jantar Mantar as Delhi's key protest venue. Delhi HC questioned whether demonstrations should continue in the heart of the capital. Justice Amit Mahajan orally observed that protests should not inconvenience the city and asked, "Why should the city be put to ransom unnecessarily?"

Article Title: Cabbie, 22, killed by Passengers During Ride to Jaipur
Article Text: New Delhi: A cab driver was allegedly murdered by a group of passengers en route to Jaipur, Rajasthan . The deceased, Ashish Pal, 22, a native of Auraiya, UP, and resident of Noida, had gone missing on July 20. His body was recovered two days later from Jaipur Rural.Police traced the case to Delhi based on the last location of the cab. A case was registered before police nabbed the accused—four adults and a juvenile.They had come to Delhi on July 18 for a visit. On July 20, they booked Ashish’s cab near a hospital in Jasola for Jaipur for Rs 6,500, and began their journey via Mumbai Expressway. Meanwhile, one of them planned to steal the cab and sell it, and persuaded others to join him.Around 40-50 km before Jaipur, one of them asked Ashish to stop for toilet at an isolated place. Then two of them overpowered him and strangled him to death in the car. After dumping Ashish’s body by the roadside, the accused fled in the cab with his mobile phone and wallet, police said.The accused were held after raiding multiple locations. Three of them committed the murder while two helped them escape, police said.
Article Summary: The deceased, Ashish Pal, 22, a native of Auraiya, UP, and resident of Noida, had gone missing on July 20. His body was recovered two days later from Jaipur Rural. Police traced the case to Delhi based on the last location of the cab.

Article Title: PM Modi has time to meet defected UBT MPs but not Gen Z: Uddhav Thackeray
Article Text:
“Modi doesn’t have time to meet Gen Z. Modi doesn’t have time to come to Parliament, but he has time to meet traitors [Sena UBT MPs],” Uddhav said.





Mumbai: Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray has criticised Prime Minister Narendra Modi for meeting defected Sena (UBT) MPs over breakfast in New Delhi recently.“Modi doesn’t have time to meet Gen Z. Modi doesn’t have time to come to Parliament, but he has time to meet traitors [Sena UBT MPs],” Uddhav said.He also took a dig at RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s interaction with Gen Z. Uddhav said if the RSS is running the govt and the RSS’s govt is listening, then before Bhagwat engages in conversation with children, he should have sought Union home minister Amit Shah’s resignation.“Don’t you have time to meet the youth who are protesting for justice and rights, and shamelessly, you meet the traitors and tell them ‘I am with you’? What was the reason for these traitors to go and meet him (Modi) while the hearing was ongoing in court? What message are they sending? Is he threatening the court? This matter is serious. What exactly are traitors afraid of? Even after being washed in a washing machine, why do you wag your tails and go to Modi?” Uddhav said.“Today, the entire opposition and the country are demanding answers from the Prime Minister and the home minister. Why are you perpetrating these atrocities on the youth? However, the Prime Minister has no intention of speaking, and the home minister lacks the courage," Uddhav alleged.“This fight is not limited merely to Shiv Sena; this virus of treason has spread across the entire country. The hearing of the case, pending for the last 4 years in the matter of the Shiv Sena party, has begun. Our simple expectation is that the verdict be delivered in accordance with the Constitution, and it will be; I am certain of this, as we have respect and faith in the court,” Uddhav said.Shiv Sena chief Eknath Shinde visited Delhi on Friday and met PM Narendra Modi in Parliament. Modi also met the six Sena (UBT) MPs who joined Shinde’s party recently.
Article Summary: Uddhav Thackeray has criticised Prime Minister Narendra Modi for meeting defected Sena (UBT) MPs over breakfast in New Delhi. He also took a dig at RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s interaction with Gen Z. “Don’t you have time to meet the youth who are protesting for justice and rights, and shamelessly, you meet the traitors,” he said.

Article Title: Euro Kids Staff Booked After Boy Injured at Kanjur Marg Daycare
Article Text:
Mumbai:





A seven-year-old boy allegedly sustained an injury to his upper lip after being hit with a plastic bottle by a daycare staff member at Euro Kids Runwal Forest, Kanjur Marg.The Vikhroli police have booked the staffer under the Juvenile Justice Act.According to the police on Aug 4, the child was at the daycare from 3 pm to 8 pm as both his parents work. When his mother arrived to pick him up at around 8 pm, staff allegedly claimed that he had fallen while playing. However, after reaching home, the child told his mother that a daycare staff member had thrown a plastic bottle at him. He was subsequently taken to Fortis Hospital for treatment, following which his parents lodged a complaint against the staffer.
Article Summary: A seven-year-old boy allegedly sustained an injury to his upper lip after being hit with a plastic bottle by a daycare staff member at Euro Kids Runwal Forest, Kanjur Marg. The Vikhroli police have booked the staffer under the Juvenile Justice Act.

Article Title: Pvt vehicles banned in an around CPR Hospital till Sunday afternoon
Article Text:
Private vehicles banned in CPR Hospital

Kolhapur

:





Private vehicles have been banned in and around Chhatrapati Pramila Raje (CPR) civil hospital from Friday afternoon until Sunday afternoon, as several development works within the hospital premises are set to be inaugurated in the presence of chief minister Devendra Fadnavis , deputy chief ministers and other ministers.The hospital dean issued a notification clarifying that the restrictions will not apply to emergency vehicles, and that adequate precautions have been taken to avoid any inconvenience to patients and their relatives.The hospital is located along the busy Bhausingji Road which is home to several govt establishments. Directly opposite the hospital stands the building of the Bombay High Court’s Kolhapur bench.Though the ban of private vehicles on paper was supposed to start from 12pm, the security deployment at the hospital started the enforcement from morning which caught the visitors by surprise.As a result, the road got congested and the traffic department had to deploy additional staff to regulate movement of vehicles.“The restrictions have been placed for security reasons. It is approved by the police department. The visitors are requested to cooperate,” CPR Hospital dean Dr Sadanand Bhise said.
Article Summary: Private vehicles have been banned in and around Chhatrapati Pramila Raje (CPR) civil hospital from Friday afternoon until Sunday afternoon. Several development works within the hospital premises are set to be inaugurated in the presence of chief minister Devendra Fadnavis.

Article Title: Bombay high court grants bail to Solapur BJP corporator in MNS politician murder case
Article Text:
Police personnel took BJP Solapur corporator Shalan Shinde from jail to a polling booth to cast her vote for the recent MLC election

Kolhapur:





The Bombay high court’s Kolhapur bench has granted bail to Solapur Municipal Corporation’s BJP corporator Shalan Shankar Shinde, who is one of the accused in the murder of Maharashtra Navnirman Sena students’ wing city chief Balasaheb Sarwade earlier this year.Shinde was arrested along with seven others, including her husband, sons, sister and supporters, following Sarwade’s murder on Jan 2. According to the prosecution, Sarwade had filed his nomination for the Solapur Municipal Corporation elections and was allegedly pressured to withdraw it. Though he withdrew his candidature, he allegedly confronted the Shinde family over the treatment meted out to his relatives shortly before he was killed.Shinde subsequently won the civic election while in judicial custody and had recently been permitted to cast her vote in the MLC election. After her sister, Sharda Shinde, secured bail, Shalan Shinde approached the high court seeking regular bail. The plea was opposed by the prosecution and by Bajirao Pandurang Sarwade, brother of the deceased.“The applicant is a prominent resident of the area and is a sitting corporator.The applicant has deep roots in the society and is not a flight risk. The applicant also does not have criminal antecedents. The applicant is ready to abide by any condition that may be imposed by this court. The applicant may, therefore, be released on bail,” Shinde’s counsel argued before the court, according to the Aug 4 order.Opposing the plea, the prosecution and intervenor argued that Shinde was directly named in the FIR and had an active role in the crime.“The applicant is directly named in the FIR. The applicant is also attributed the role of throwing the chili powder. The applicant is also attributed exhortation to the other accused persons to kill deceased Balasaheb Sarwade... The offence is serious in nature. As the applicant is a sitting corporator, there is every likelihood that the applicant, if released on bail, may influence the witnesses,” they submitted.Granting bail, Justice Mehroz K Pathan noted discrepancies in eyewitness accounts and the limited role attributed to Shinde in the FIR.“The apprehensions of the learned APP as well as the learned counsel for the complainant can be taken care of by imposing stringent conditions upon the applicant. The applicant is a woman and has a family to look after. The investigation is complete and the chargesheet is filed. No fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the woman behind bars. Taking into consideration the limited role attributed to the applicant in the FIR and the material discrepancy, occurring in the statements of the eye witnesses, I am inclined to exercise discretion under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023,” stated Justice Pathan before allowing the bail application and imposing conditions such as personal bond of Rs 1 lakh, showing up at police station once in two months and not entering the jurisdiction of the Jail Road police station untill framing of charges, except when required to mark her attendance.
Article Summary: Shalan Shankar Shinde is one of the accused in the murder of Maharashtra Navnirman Sena students’ wing city chief Balasaheb Sarwade earlier this year. She was arrested along with seven others, including her husband, sons, sister and supporters.

Article Title: Two women die in separate accidents involving PMPML buses
Article Text:
Representative image

Pune:





Two women died in separate accidents involving PMPML buses in the city on Friday. One in the morning, another in the afternoon.A PMPML bus hit a scooter on which Sunita Kate (54) of Akurdi was riding pillion with her son on the Pune-Nagar highway at Chandannagar on Friday morning. Kate’s son was driving the scooter towards Wagholi from Pune when the bus sped away from the spot.Kate died, while her son sustained injuries. Kate’s brother, Sunil Nagwade (47) of Pimple Gurav, lodged a complaint with the Airport police. A police inspector said, “It is a hit-and-run case and we are studying the CCTV footage of the spot to ascertain the registration number of the PMPML bus involved in the accident.”In another incident, Nirmala Naresh Pillai (57) of Bopodi died on the Pune-Mumbai road on Friday afternoon after a PMPML bus hit her. Khadki police arrested the PMPML bus driver (22) and released him after serving a notice. Pillai’s daughter, Priti Murti (32) of Bopodi, lodged a complaint with the police saying, “My mother was walking towards Khadki from Bopodi when the bus hit her and she died.”
Article Summary: A PMPML bus hit a scooter on which Sunita Kate (54) of Akurdi was riding pillion with her son on the Pune-Nagar highway at Chandannagar on Friday morning. Kate’s son was driving the scooter towards Wagholi from Pune when the bus sped away from the spot.

Article Title: Bawankule retort to Jarange quota swipe
Article Text:
Wardha:





Responding to Manoj Jarange’s allegations against him, revenue minister and Nagpur and Amravati guardian minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule on Saturday said he belonged to both the OBC and Maratha communities and did not believe in acting against or accusing anyone.Jarange, during a tour of western Maharashtra, had alleged that an attempt was being made to cancel the registration of 58 lakh Marathas and claimed CM Devendra Fadnavis and Bawankule were involved.Bawankule said, “Just as I belong to OBC community, I also belong to the Maratha community. We do not discriminate within the family. We are working to secure whatever rights the Maratha community is entitled to.”He maintained that Mahayuti govt was committed to ensuring justice to both communities on the matter of caste certificates. “The Maharashtra govt is completely with the Maratha community. OBC community too should get justice, and while ensuring justice to the OBC community, the rights of the Maratha community should also not be affected,” Bawankule said.On MNS chief Raj Thackeray ’s remarks over tenders for works related to Nashik Kumbh Mela, Bawankule said the online tender process was transparent and asked those concerned to verify facts with the list of tenders before commenting. He said contractors from any state could participate in the online tender process, citing the example of a tender for a 300-bed hospital in Arvi, and added that quality was given importance regardless of which state a contractor came from.On talk of NCP (Sharad Pawar) functionaries meeting PM Narendra Modi, Bawankule said such meetings kept happening. “Various people meet PM over development works,” he said.
Article Summary: Chandrashekhar Bawankule said he belonged to both the OBC and Maratha communities. He said the Maharashtra govt was committed to ensuring justice to both communities on the matter of caste certificates. On MNS chief Raj Thackeray ’s remarks over tenders for works related to Nashik Kumbh Mela, he said the online tender process was transparent.

Article Title: Former BJP state general secretary arrested in Atrocities Act case
Article Text:
The case stems from an audio clip that went viral on social media last month

Nashik:





Former BJP state general secretary Vijay Chaudhary was arrested on Thursday in connection with a case registered against him under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.The case stems from an audio clip that went viral on social media last month, in which Chaudhary was allegedly heard making objectionable and casteist remarks against former Nandurbar MP Heena Gavit. Based on a complaint, the Nandurbar city police registered an FIR against him on July 28 under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for outraging modesty and sections of the Atrocities Act.Nandurbar sub-divisional police officer Hanumant Gaikwad said Chaudhary had been evading arrest since the FIR was filed. Acting on a tip-off, the local crime branch tracked him to a location on Thursday, detained him and handed him over to the investigating team.Chaudhary was arrested later that night and produced before a court, which remanded him to police custody till Aug 10. Gaikwad said, “Investigators will collect Chaudhary’s voice sample and send it for forensic analysis to verify whether it matches the voice heard in the viral audio clip.We will also probe the origin and circulation of the recording to determine who made it public.”Following the registration of the FIR, Chaudhary resigned from his post as BJP’s North Maharashtra coordinator.In a separate development, the Akkalkuwa police registered another case against Chaudhary on Aug 4 based on a complaint filed by Giridhar Dharma Padvi, secretary of the Akhil Bharatiya Adivasi Mahasangh. The complaint alleges that Chaudhary made derogatory and defamatory remarks about MLA Amshya Padvi, a member of the Bhil Scheduled Tribe community, during a phone conversation.
Article Summary: Vijay Chaudhary was arrested on Thursday in connection with a case registered against him under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act. The case stems from an audio clip that went viral on social media last month.

Article Title: T T V Dhinakaran urges action on fishers’ crisis
Article Text:
Urges permanent solution

Chennai:





AMMK general secretary T T V Dhinakaran on Saturday criticised chief minister C Joseph Vijay’s handling of the recurring fishermen crisis and urged the state and Union govts to take concrete steps towards a permanent solution.Dhinakaran alleged that Vijay had done little beyond writing routine letters to the Centre. Before the elections, Vijay had criticised previous govts for “writing letters to the Centre and going to sleep” whenever fishermen were arrested, he said. However, three months after assuming office, Vijay had adopted the same approach without delivering results, Dhinakaran alleged. His statement came in the backdrop of protests by Rameswaram fishermen against the detention of 11 fishermen and the seizure of their boats by the Sri Lankan Navy.
Article Summary: AMMK general secretary T T V Dhinakaran criticised chief minister C Joseph Vijay’s handling of the recurring fishermen crisis. His statement came in the backdrop of protests by Rameswaram fishermen against the detention of 11 fishermen and the seizure of their boats by the Sri Lanka Navy.

Article Title: Amit Shah offers prayers at Tiruvannamalai temple
Article Text:
During his visit to the Tiruvannamalai temple, Shah offered prayers across various sanctums, including the Sambandha Vinayagar shrine, the main Annamalaiyar shrine, and the Unnamalai Amman shrine.





TIRUVANNAMALAI/PUDUCHERRY: Union home minister Amit Shah arrived in Tiruvannamalai on Saturday, as part of his two-day visit to Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. He offered prayers at the revered Arulmigu Arunachaleswarar temple and Sri Ramana Maharshi Ashram.Having arrived in Chennai from Mumbai earlier in the day, the home minister flew by helicopter to a landing facility near Tiruvannamalai. From there, he proceeded by road to the ancient Arunachaleswarar temple, one of the foremost Panchabhoota Sthalams representing the element of fire.During his visit to the temple, Shah offered prayers across various sanctums, including the Sambandha Vinayagar shrine, the main Annamalaiyar shrine, and the Unnamalai Amman shrine. Upon concluding his prayers, temple authorities and police officials presented him with traditional garlands and prasadam. Upon exiting the temple complex, Shah greeted waiting devotees, members of the public, and BJP workers with folded hands.Following his temple visit, Shah travelled along the Girivalam path to the Sri Ramana Maharshi Ashram, where he participated in special prayers and rituals. After completing his spiritual engagements in Tiruvannamalai, Shah departed by road for Puducherry.Shah is scheduled to attend the presentation ceremony of the President’s Police Colour to the Puducherry Police on Sunday morning at the Puducherry Police Ground. He will later proceed to a hotel for scheduled organisational and official meetings, followed by lunch. He will flag off a 'Tricolour in every house' rally in the town. Shah will depart from Puducherry Airport in an IAF helicopter at 2.10pm, reaching Chennai airport by 2.55pm before boarding an IAF aircraft to return to New Delhi.
Article Summary: Union home minister Amit Shah arrived in Tiruvannamalai on Saturday, as part of his two-day visit to Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. He offered prayers at the revered Arulmigu Arunachaleswarar temple and Sri Ramana Maharshi Ashram.

Article Title: TN law commission reconstituted; brief includes suggesting legal reforms and making recommendations on Centre-state relations
Article Text:
Representative image





CHENNAI: The Tamil Nadu govt has reconstituted the law commission for a three-year term, entrusting it with the tasks of suggesting measures to plug loopholes in existing laws and making recommendations on interstate and Centre-State relations.The reconstituted commission will be headed by former Manipur high court chief justice D Krishnakumar as chairman. Former Madras high court judge RMT Teekaa Raman, former additional chief secretary TK Ramachandran and former law department secretary A Arunagiri have been appointed as full-time members.Former district judges P Mohan Doss and R Govindarajan have been appointed as part-time members, while an officer in the cadre of secretary, law department, will serve as the full-time member secretary.According to the law dept's GO dated Aug 7, the commission has been asked to suggest suitable modifications or amendments to plug loopholes in existing laws and recommend social and economic legislative measures.It will also suggest ways and means for interstate relations and Centre-state relations and make recommendations for judicial and administrative reforms aimed at improving and expediting procedures.The commission has further been tasked with suggesting amendments not only to state laws but also to Central laws applicable to Tamil Nadu, besides recommending rationalisation of Acts and laws in the state.It will consider references made by the govt on legislation involving more than one department and matters relating to law and judicial administration.
Article Summary: The reconstituted commission will be headed by former Manipur high court chief justice D Krishnakumar. Former Madras high court judge RMT Teekaa Raman, former additional chief secretary TK Ramachandran and former law department secretary A Arunagiri will serve as full-time members.

Article Title: Man murders brother with help of friend near Coimbatore, arrested after mother informs cops three days later
Article Text:
Representative image





COIMBATORE: Three days after her younger son murdered her elder son with the help of his friend and a day after the body was found, a 65-year-old woman walked into the PN Palayam police station in Coimbatore district and revealed the crime, which led to the arrest of the culprits.The murdered man has been identified as D Senthilkumar, 45, of Vellamadai near PN Palayam. Police arrested his younger brother, Sampathkumar, 42, and his friend, M Anandkumar, 24, of Vellamadai on murder charges.On Thursday night, Vellamadai village administrative officer (VAO) Karthik,49, alerted police about an odour emanating from a 25-foot-deep abandoned well on a piece of vacant land in Andal Nagar. Police with the help of fire and rescue services personnel retrieved a decomposed body of a man from the well.Initial investigations led police to register a case of suspicious death under Section 194 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, as the identity of the victim could not be established.On Friday, Saraswathi of Andal Nagar walked into the police station and stated that a heated altercation broke out at her residence between her elder son, Senthilkumar, and her younger son, Sambathkumar, on Tuesday night (Aug 4).During the argument, Sampathkumar, along with his friend, M Anandkumar, 24, of Vellamadai, assaulted Senthilkumar and stabbed him repeatedly with a knife, killing him on the spot.After her statement, police altered it into a murder case and arrested the duo on Friday. Investigations revealed that the duo, after murdering Senthilkumar, transported his body on a two-wheeler and dumped it into the abandoned well.They were remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: A 65-year-old woman walked into the PN Palayam police station in Coimbatore district and revealed the crime, which led to the arrest of the culprits. The murdered man has been identified as D Senthilkumar, 45, of Vellamadai. Police arrested his younger brother, Sampathkumar, 42, and his friend, M Anandk Kumar, 24, on murder charges.

Article Title: Truck driver dies in road accident near Salem
Article Text: SALEM: A driver died in an accident involving a truck, a pickup van and a bus near Mecheri in Salem district on Wednesday. More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident.According to the Mecheri police, a TNSTC bus carrying 51 passengers was heading to Karur from Mettur when a speeding pickup van attempted to overtake it. “The pickup van collided head-on with a truck coming from the opposite direction,” said an officer at the Mecheri police station. The truck grazed the bus, shattering its windows and injuring more than 10 passengers seated near the windows.Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. The injured were rushed to govt hospitals in Mettur and Omalur.Fire service personnel, assisted by Mecheri police and residents, worked to move the damaged truck and pickup van to the roadside. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.The Mecheri police registered a case.
Article Summary: More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident. Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.
